sources.fact: Apache-2.0; released models usable commercially free of charge; local SentenceTransformer example; 768 dimensions; 8192 token context; query prefix required. Compute is not priced here.
MIT license; 1024 dimensions; 8192 sequence length; local FlagEmbedding example; dense, sparse and multi-vector retrieval; more than 100 working languages.

Hosted voyage-4 family, voyage-code-4 and older models; open-weight voyage-4-nano also offered; 4-family default dimension 1024 with 256/512/2048 options and 32000 context. General/multilingual and code are distinct model choices.
USD per million input tokens: voyage-4-large 0.12, voyage-4 0.06, voyage-4-lite 0.02, voyage-code-4 0.12. Standard endpoint list prices after allowances; Batch has separate discount/credit rules.

Hosted text-embedding-3-small and text-embedding-3-large API; default 1536 and 3072 dimensions; dimensions can be shortened; max input 8192; guide includes code-search example. No downloadable weights established by this source.
Specialized models, Standard: text-embedding-3-small USD 0.02 per million input tokens; text-embedding-3-large USD 0.13.
Cloudflare-hosted @cf/baai/bge-m3; USD 0.0118 per million input tokens; page advertises 60000-token context. Hosted API boundary is not evidence of equivalence to local BAAI/bge-m3.

candidates.cost: No model-license charge; own hardware, power, operations and throughput cost unmeasured. Not Snowflake Cortex pricing.
candidates.self_hostability: Yes: downloadable Apache-2.0 weights and local usage example.
candidates.mixed_corpus: Multilingual text; 768-D base. Pin existing revision and preprocessing; do not compare or merge vectors across candidate spaces. Repository mixed-corpus quality unmeasured.

candidates.cost: No hosted token rate for self-hosting established; hardware, serving and storage cost unmeasured. MIT model license, not zero operating cost.
candidates.self_hostability: Yes: downloadable MIT weights and local FlagEmbedding usage.
candidates.mixed_corpus: Multilingual dense/sparse/multi-vector capability is vendor-documented, not repository quality evidence. 1024-D dense vectors and 8192 tokens; multi-vector outputs need different indexing, not a drop-in 768-D table.

candidates.cost: Standard USD/M input tokens: voyage-4-lite 0.02, voyage-4 0.06, voyage-4-large/code-4 0.12 after allowances; choose model before estimating total corpus cost.
candidates.self_hostability: Family-dependent: hosted APIs are distinct from open-weight voyage-4-nano; nano license, hardware sizing and operating cost not evaluated in this slice. Do not label whole family closed or self-hostable.
candidates.mixed_corpus: General multilingual and code-specialized variants; pin concrete model, revision, dimensions and query/document input_type before integration. Family label is not a pipeline identity; repository quality unmeasured.

candidates.cost: Standard USD/M input tokens: small 0.02; large 0.13. Excludes storage, retrieval, retries and model-specific tokenization effects.
candidates.self_hostability: Hosted API documented; no self-hostable weights established for these exact models in retrieved sources. Not proof that all OpenAI products are closed.
candidates.mixed_corpus: Guide documents text and code-search uses, not repository mixed-corpus quality. Pin small/large plus dimensions (1536/3072 defaults) and preprocessing; shortened vectors remain their own qualified pipeline.

candidates.cost: For concrete hosted @cf/baai/bge-m3, USD 0.0118/M input tokens on retrieved model page. Workers/runtime/storage charges and allowances are outside this figure.
candidates.self_hostability: Workers AI is Cloudflare-hosted. Underlying BAAI model can be self-hosted separately, but that is the BGE-M3 row, not the same serving identity.
candidates.mixed_corpus: Hosted BGE-M3 advertises multilingual/multi-granularity text. Vendor page lists 60000 context versus upstream BAAI 8192; unresolved API/model boundary discrepancy, never infer identical preprocessing or vector compatibility. Repository quality unmeasured.
